title: Entre semana y el fin de semana
communication_goal: Comparar rutinas de días laborales y fines de semana usando frecuencia y conectores.
situation: Cuentas qué haces entre semana y cómo cambia tu rutina el sábado o domingo.

dialogue.speaker: Mia
dialogue.english: What do you do on weekdays?

dialogue.speaker: Leo
dialogue.english: I work and study English. I usually wake up early.
dialogue.spanish: Trabajo y estudio inglés. Normalmente me despierto temprano.

dialogue.speaker: Leo
dialogue.english: I don't work. I sleep late and visit friends.
dialogue.spanish: No trabajo. Duermo hasta tarde y visito amigos.

dialogue.speaker: Mia
dialogue.english: I usually go shopping on Saturdays, but I relax on Sundays.
dialogue.spanish: Normalmente voy de compras los sábados, pero descanso los domingos.

explanation_es: Usa on weekdays y on weekends para hablar de periodos. Los adverbios expresan frecuencia: I usually wake up early; I sometimes go shopping. Conecta diferencias con but: I work on weekdays, but I don't work on weekends. La pregunta What about weekends? invita a comparar.
spanish_speaker_notes: Weekday es un día de lunes a viernes; weekend es sábado y domingo.
No digas in weekends en este patrón; usa on weekends.
Sleep late no significa dormir mal, sino levantarse tarde.
Relax puede ser una actividad completa: I relax at home.

targets.text: What do you do on weekdays?

pronunciation.tip_es: Marca el contraste con la entonación: weekdays, but weekends.

reading.title: A balanced weekend
reading.text: Mia works on weekdays and usually wakes up early. On Saturdays, she goes shopping and visits friends. On Sundays, she never works and relaxes at home. Her weekend is different from her weekday routine.

activities.instruction: Clasifica las actividades como más comunes entre semana o el fin de semana.
Escucha: I sleep late and visit friends on weekends. Elige la descripción.
activities.audio_text: I sleep late and visit friends on weekends.

activities.instruction: Completa: I work ___ weekdays, but I relax ___ weekends.
activities.feedback: Usamos on con weekdays y weekends.

activities.instruction: Ordena: usually / I / friends / visit / weekends / on / .
activities.answer: I usually visit friends on weekends.
activities.feedback: Usually va antes del verbo principal y on weekends al final.

activities.instruction: Corrige: I sleep late in weekends.
Compara tus rutinas: On weekdays I... but on weekends I....
activities.target: On weekdays I ... but on weekends I ...

activities.instruction: Lee A Balanced Weekend y responde: What does Mia do on Sundays?
activities.answer: She never works and relaxes at home.
activities.feedback: La última parte describe el domingo.

activities.instruction: La IA será un amigo comparando fines de semana. Responde preguntas y haz una pregunta sobre su rutina.
Graba una comparación de 45 segundos entre tu rutina de lunes a viernes y tu fin de semana usando cinco actividades y tres frecuencias.
Completa: entre semana = on ___; fin de semana = on ___; dormir tarde = sleep ___.

mastery_criteria.retry: Si mezclas los periodos, escribe dos columnas: weekdays y weekends, y coloca cada actividad antes de hablar.
